h: Atiku fires back after Tinubu blames opponents for hunger
p: At the APC campaign flag-off in Kaduna, President Tinubu reportedly asked who created hunger and poverty and answered that his rivals did. Atiku Abubakar has replied that blaming the opposition is either delusion or political amnesia, pointing out that the APC governed for eight years before Tinubu took office. He cited the naira's slide from about ₦471 to ₦1,329 to the dollar and World Bank poverty projections.
more: Atiku also questioned trillions of naira recorded under energy security spending.
The exchange sharpens the 2027 battle between the APC and the ADC.
Supporters on both sides are trading the clips online.
